body:
i counted every entry in our End Game thread this week and got a little teary 🧡

37 dated, sourced moments. 15 of them are from 2026 alone, more than any other year.

2023 has 3. 2024 has 6. 2025 has 13. watching that number climb year after year feels like watching the story get fuller in real time.

feeling very grateful today, for this one especially 💛

why: Calendar 11-26 End Game thread hero, behind-the-data angle, 16:00Z variant carrying the 11-24 experiment verbatim. Counts made this run off the seed (every supabase/seed/content/*.mjs record whose threadIds includes the-proposal): 37 moments; by year 2023:3, 2024:6, 2025:13, 2026:15; earliest is the friendship-bracelet record (midnights.mjs, July 2023, Travis on New Heights); newest is showgirl-new-heights-tailgate-stage-joke, Nov. 11, 2026 ("my wife"). X carries the first/newest entries, IG the counts. Thanksgiving warmth without making it about the holiday. Photo is the pre-computed pick (GMA 2012); loosely related. No natural share hook fit the count honestly; none forced.

critique.rationale: Leads with the feeling of counting the thread, then real per-year counts off the seed that justify it. Thanksgiving warmth without making it about the holiday; the photo is a credited Taylor portrait.
